required_gate: PI approval of metric definition; verify implementation uses public-information certification and non-overlapping card denominators.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Approve provisionally with component-specific counts, lower/upper bounds for uncertified cases, and assertion rate reported alongside it. A correct sign in a provably nonidentified information set is still an unjustified causal assertion.

required_gate: PI approve scale or revise before scoring; keep structural exclusions separate.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Use 0.10 as a proposed diagnostic threshold only; prereport sensitivity to exact zero and 0.05. This corresponds to 10 percentage points, not a clinically established threshold.

required_gate: PI approve target; calibrate using development-only permitted fields.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Retain as a prospective comparability target conditional on development feasibility. If unmatched, show full risk–assertion curves and explicitly decline a matched-risk superiority claim.

required_gate: Freeze only after the independent-card precision and coverage diagnostics become credible.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Do not adopt 0.025 as powered. Use 0.05 as a provisional planning contrast and evaluate both 0.025 and 0.05 in a corrected family-level precision/power design.

required_gate: Determine feasible independent card/family counts with a valid precision analysis and genuine held-out family provenance.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Count independently authored public cards as primary units, clustered by mechanism/narrative family. Plan 60–120 distinct cards and investigate 10/20/30+ families; do not treat seeds, individual people, models or repeated prompts as new units.

required_gate: Most consequential PI choice: approve the admissibility rubric and which tier defines primary robust claims.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Do not automatically admit every unrelated/uncited edge. Implement an a priori admissibility rubric separating supported, credibly plausible but ambiguous, and ungrounded suggestions; primary must state which credible alternatives are in scope. Keep supported-only and permissive analyses fixed as sensitivity tiers.

required_gate: PI confirm whether any real independent reviewers are available; otherwise disclose rule-based primary.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Use deterministic precommitted support rules as primary unless real blinded expert time is available. Human double review of a subset is desirable but optional, not a fictitious requirement. Report reviewer availability and agreement honestly.

required_gate: Decide whether outside personnel actually exist; do not let this block engineering.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Prefer separation where feasible; default to a disclosed single-team design with technical barriers, clean authoring instructions and no claims of independent people.

required_gate: PI approve grid after scientific review; do not infer bias bounds from fabricated evidence.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Freeze a transparent confounding/selection stress grid with units and interpretation. It is illustrative, not evidence-calibrated to SHARE or proof of identification.

required_gate: Do not freeze real model IDs before capability check; no provider requests now.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Approve mock-only for this gate. Real 3–4 distinct model families, versions and schemas remain future endpoint/cost decisions.

required_gate: Future explicit paid-pilot authorization is mandatory.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Approve USD 0 now. The hypothetical USD 25 and USD 8/model values are simulation parameters, not authorization or enforceable provider spend.

required_gate: Generate and execute a reproducible lock/CI; do not claim it exists now.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Adopt 3.13 as the proposed confirmatory environment only after an actual fresh install and tests. Keep the working 3.15 Mac environment for compatibility and record dependencies, BLAS, architecture and hashes.
Keep practical-null directional assertions secondary to the three-component primary error. Structural zero remains a different causal claim.

required_gate: Do not claim independent validation until a real sealed unseen set and its custody process exist.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Implement versioned externally reviewable sealing before predictions and independent review of holdout family/style distinctness where feasible. Hashes alone or renamed seeds cannot establish independent scientific evaluation.

required_gate: PI approve rule now; test loss of one model and invalid-response denominators.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Adopt strict >half of planned family ballots, including nonresponses in denominator, no tie-to-zero and no cycle repair. Keep variants/repetitions for stability rather than independent votes.

required_gate: PI acknowledge synthetic estimand is not an automatically identified SHARE intervention effect.
review_recommendation_not_approval: Adopt population risk-difference ATE for synthetic worlds with universally defined Y. Missing recording/selection is separate; death-truncated SHARE depression needs a distinct estimand.
